findings.desc: delivery-check-hash.ts:94 advisory field is optional on DeliveryCheckFreshnessResult but is semantically required when code===delivery_check_drift_advisory; missing discriminated union means a future code path returning that code without advisory would silently swallow the advisory (done-oracle uses the defensive ? empty-string guard at line 629). The type should enforce advisory presence for the advisory code.

CHK-001:happy:2 must-intent (delivery_waiver_add re-sign preserves storyFilesHash) has no dynamic execution evidence: the smoke never calls delivery_waiver_add, and the evidence note explicitly admits this ("The smoke test ... does not have an explicit waiver case"). The submitted evidence is kind=logic_test + a grep command that confirms the field is referenced in source, but this cannot catch a runtime defect such as reading an old-format record that lacks storyFilesHash and silently passing undefined to re-sign. A must-priority cli-type intent requires either a smoke/integration_test call exercising the actual waiver path or a waiver with a clear rationale for why automation is impractical.
